details:
Thank you for reading. I think a lot of VRChatters (like me, for example) are actually quite worried about whether VRChat Inc.'s making enough revenue to properly maintain the service.

Like, for example...... when downloading and loading world data, I remember there used to be something like a help pop-up showing every few seconds, right?

So I was thinking, maybe bringing that frame back and displaying ads there could be an option?

If it's just ads in that kind of moment, I feel like it wouldn’t really hurt the user experience that much, and at the same time, VRC Inc. could earn some revenue through advertising...... that's what I was thinking, at least.

Right now, we're seeing a lot of VR services shutting down, and honestly, that’s rly sad for us.

For me personally, I've been using this platform for a long time, so I just want it to last as long as possible.

Of course, how they actually make money's up to VRChat Inc., but, maybe it could be worth considering this as one possible opt?

My English's not good, so I might say smth rude. My bad about that.
title: What if we added ADs to the loading screens when moving between worlds?
